# Publications and research outputs

My work spans applied AI, behavioural economics, complex systems, computational social science, innovation, public policy and engineering-related decision-making. Below is a publication list based on my academic CV (October 2026). For an automatically updated record, please see my [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com.au/citations?user=ARJITb8AAAAJ), [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9579-4231) and [QUT academic profile](https://www.qut.edu.au/about/our-people/academic-profiles/s.bickley).
